_doc: Hand-written skits used ONLY when no free model is reachable (and by test mode). Each is posted at most once.

scripts.title: My calendar is fully booked 📅
scripts.description: Running a company is hard when you are the whole company.
scripts.topic: the founder cancels his own meetings
scripts.canonical_en: A CEO's calendar is full of meetings with himself that he cancels himself

lines.text: Ever since I became my own boss, my calendar has been fully booked.
At ten I have a meeting with the founder.
At eleven the founder cancels on me.
At twelve I give the founder a warning.
Because the founder, the CEO and the intern are all me.
And honestly, the intern is carrying this company.

scripts.title: The 5 a.m. CEO routine ☕
scripts.description: Discipline is everything. Especially when there is nothing to do.
scripts.topic: a 5 a.m. routine for a company that does not exist
scripts.canonical_en: A founder's strict 5 a.m. routine ends with him back in bed because the company does not exist

lines.text: I wake up at five a.m. because empires don't build themselves.
I check my emails before I brush my teeth.
Black coffee. No sugar. No breaks.
By six I am already at my desk.
By seven I am back in bed.
Because there is nothing to do until the company exists.

scripts.title: How I manage a big team 🪴
scripts.description: Leadership is about listening to your team. My team is a great listener.
scripts.topic: the CEO's whole team is a potted plant
scripts.canonical_en: A CEO brags about managing his team but the team is a potted plant

lines.text: People ask how I manage such a big team.
We have a strict no excuses culture.
Every morning, I give a motivational speech.
Then I take feedback from the team.
The team says the speech was amazing.
The team is a plant.
It still shows up more than I do.

scripts.title: I finally met an investor 💼
scripts.description: Pitched my startup. The investor had questions. And dinner.
scripts.topic: the only investor is his dad
scripts.canonical_en: A founder pitches to an investor who turns out to be his dad

lines.text: This year I finally met an investor.
He asked about my revenue, my team and my product.
I said, sir, we are in stealth mode.
He said five years of stealth mode is called sleeping.
The investor was my dad.
Funding was not approved. Dinner was.

scripts.title: My premium office tour ☕
scripts.description: Fast wifi, city view, zero rent. Some call it a cafe.
scripts.topic: his premium office is a cafe
scripts.canonical_en: A founder shows off his premium office which is a cafe he has been sitting in for days

lines.text: Every serious founder needs a premium office.
Mine has fast wifi, unlimited coffee and a city view.
Rent is just one cappuccino a day.
Clients love meeting me here.
Mostly because it is a cafe, and I have been here since Monday.
The barista just made me employee of the month.

scripts.title: Humbled to announce my new chapter 🙏
scripts.description: Some call it getting fired. I call it a pivot.
scripts.topic: a LinkedIn announcement that is really getting fired
scripts.canonical_en: A humble LinkedIn post about starting a venture is really about being fired this morning

lines.text: Today I am humbled to announce a new chapter in my journey.
After years of grinding, I am starting my own venture.
No boss. No office. No fixed salary.
Mostly no salary.
My company let me go this morning, and I am calling it a pivot.
